title: Phase 2 — publish the cross-language contract
description: EIGHT CORE GO TESTS read fixtures out of cloud/factory/test/fixtures/ — the dependency runs backwards from what anyone would predict. They are deliberate Go/TS drift detectors: .tick/runners.toml is parsed by internal/herd/config AND re-implemented in cloud/factory/src/{toml,repo-config}.ts, and the fixtures are what stop the two diverging. Same for sandbox worker boot and message context. internal/gatewaytrace/trace_test.go:332-342 pins constants against cloud/factory/src/gateway.ts by convention. Move the fixtures into a versioned artifact both repos consume (skills/ticks/references/runners-config.schema.json is the natural seed) and repoint both test suites at it. A naive extraction relocates these and silently disables eight drift detectors — the likeliest way this project does real damage.
acceptance_criteria: Deliberately breaking cloud/factory/src/toml.ts still fails a Go test, with no test reading a fixture by relative path across the repo boundary. All eight detectors demonstrably still fire — show one failing on purpose. go test ./... and the factory vitest suite green.
